## Make index rasters for England-Wales that can be used to produce maps for expert interviews

```{r}
#| label: Load packages

library(raster)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(stars)
```

```{r}
#| label: Read in spatial layers

bng <- "EPSG:27700"

#GB land cover map
lcm <- raster("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/data/raw-data/lcm-2023/gblcm2023_25m.tif")

#Read in small deer predicted indices with point geometry
df_sf <- readRDS("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/intermediate-outputs/NFI_2023_small_deer_impact_risk_sf.rds")

unique(df_sf$pred_wood_value)
unique(df_sf$pred_attraction_index)
unique(df_sf$pred_connect)
```

```{r}
#| label: Make a STARS template for rasterizing indices
#Convert the RasterLayer to a stars object
stars_template <- stars::st_as_stars(lcm)
```

```{r}
#| label: Make England-Wales connectivity index raster

 # Define the value mapping for pred_connect
connect_values <- c("Low" = 1, "Medium" = 2, "High" = 3)
df_sf$pred_connect <- connect_values[df_sf$pred_connect]

# Select geometry and value column
connect_sf <- df_sf %>% dplyr::select(geometry, pred_connect)

 #make a stars template
 # Use the template raster for extent, resolution, and CRS
 connect_r <- stars::st_rasterize(sf = connect_sf, template = stars_template)
 #connect_rast <- terra::rast(connect_r)
 
 stars::write_stars(connect_r, "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/Index_maps/small_deer_predicted_connectivity_EW.tif",overwrite=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: Make England-Wales wood value index raster

 # Define the value mapping for pred_connect
wood_values <- c("Low" = 1, "Medium" = 2, "High" = 3)
df_sf$pred_wood_value <- wood_values[df_sf$pred_wood_value]

# Select geometry and value column
wood_value_sf <- df_sf %>% dplyr::select(geometry, pred_wood_value)

 #make a stars template
 # Use the template raster for extent, resolution, and CRS
 wood_value_r <- stars::st_rasterize(sf = wood_value_sf, template = stars_template)

 stars::write_stars(wood_value_r, "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/Index_maps/small_deer_predicted_wood_palatability_EW.tif",overwrite=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: Make England-Wales raster for attraction index

# Define the value mapping for pred_connect
 attraction_index_values <- c("Low" = 1, "Medium" = 2, "High" = 3)
 df_sf$pred_attraction_index <- attraction_index_values[df_sf$pred_attraction_index]
 unique(df_sf$pred_attraction_index)
 
 #Convert to raster
 # Select the geometry and value column
attraction_index_sf <- df_sf %>% dplyr::select(geometry, pred_attraction_index)
 
 # Use the template raster for extent, resolution, and CRS
attraction_index_r <- stars::st_rasterize(sf = attraction_index_sf, template = stars_template)

 stars::write_stars(attraction_index_r, "C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/Index_maps/small_deer_attraction_index_EW.tif",overwrite=TRUE)
```
